column1: # mmsimpulse shell shortcuts.  name <TAB> default keys <TAB> description <TAB> command
# Only actions that work as a single press are here.  kglobalaccel launches a
# command and has no release event, so the shell's press/release pairs
# have no KDE equivalent and are left unbound.  Leave the key column empty to
# install an action without a default binding.
# A fourth column makes the entry run that command instead of an IPC call into
# the shell, and such an entry is bound to its key on install rather than being
# left for you to assign.  That is for keys nothing else in this session
# answers: without plasmashell the volume keys belong to a component that never
# starts, so they do nothing at all until something claims them.
# Keys with nobody home in a session without plasmashell.
